content_md: > One of the points I’ve wanted to develop in my AI philosophy is a proper account of goals. Ironically, despite their strongly consequentialist stance, the rationalist crowd has no meaningful account of them and don’t seem to realize they need one for a complete theory. That’s why they find themselves resorting to thought experiments like paperclip maximizers.
content_html: One of the points I’ve wanted to develop in my AI philosophy is a proper account of goals. Ironically, despite their strongly consequentialist stance, the rationalist crowd has no meaningful account of them and don’t seem to realize they need one for a complete theory. That’s why they find themselves resorting to thought experiments like paperclip maximizers.
